id: title:Gilbert09:stop a double clicked delete reporting a failure

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse source management UI reliability and user experience
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 implements a Set-based deduplication mechanism to prevent duplicate delete requests during a pending state, addressing a potential race condition and ensuring consistent UI loading state clearing. P1.F2.H1 provides tests for this behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test coverage of the deduplication and error handling. No production incident or adoption data is available; the benefit is inferred from the prevention of a potential race condition and UI state inconsistency.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a complete, reviewable code change. P1.F2.H1 is a test-only chunk. The instructions require inspecting every hunk, but assigning a score requires a complete, conservative group. P1.F2.H1 lacks the implementation context of P1.F1.H1. Treating them as a single group is safe, but P1.F2.H1 alone cannot establish the tier. P1.F1.H1 establishes:

observations.behavior: Adds a Set to track the source ID while the delete request is pending, preventing a second click from sending a duplicate request. Wraps the API call in a try/catch to handle failures and explicitly clears the loading state and shows an error toast. P1.F2.H1 adds tests for the duplicate-click prevention and the failure-path loading state.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents a race condition where a user double-clicks the delete button, sending two requests and receiving a 404 on the second, which could be misinterpreted as a failure. It also ensures the UI loading state is cleared regardless of success or failure, preventing a stuck spinner. This improves reliability and user experience for warehouse source management.
